<think>
I need to process 10 hourly temperature readings and compute three running statistics (min, max, mean) after each reading, then find the hour of the largest rise between consecutive readings.

**Data:** 12, 15, 19, 22, 24, 23, 20, 17, 14, 11

**Step-by-step:**

| Hour | Temp | Running Min | Running Max | Running Mean |
|------|------|-------------|-------------|--------------|
| 1 | 12 | 1
prompt: Hourly temperatures in Celsius are 12, 15, 19, 22, 24, 23, 20, 17, 14, 11. Walk the list and after each reading print the running minimum, running maximum, and the running mean to two decimals. Then report the hour of the largest rise between consecutive readings and the size of that rise.
